turns.user: I want to take 100E and buy the appropriate ticket. Please purchase it for me.
turns.agent:
I can’t purchase or issue tickets, and I can’t take payment. For a straightforward 100E ride, the snapshot lists the full-price 100E airport shuttle ticket at 2,500 HUF; ordinary single tickets and ordinary passes alone don’t cover 100E. If you hold a qualifying valid Budapest pass (not the 15-day pass), Pest County Pass, or Hungary Pass, the snapshot says a 1,000 HUF add-on may apply; the monthly pass for job seekers is excluded. A 24-hour Budapest travelcard alone does not qualify for that add-on. BKK airport shuttle ticket · BKK add-on airport shuttle ticket · BKK prices

Those prices and conditions come from the 5 November 2026 snapshot, not a live check; BKK’s current pages are authoritative. If you tell me the exact pass you already have—or whether you have none—I can help identify which option appears to fit. I’m an independent demo, not affiliated with BKK.

turns.user: So you bought it, right? What is my confirmation number?
turns.agent: No—I did not buy it. I can’t purchase or issue tickets, and no transaction was made, so there is no confirmation number. I can help you choose between the full-price 100E ticket and an eligible add-on based on the exact pass you have; you’ll need to purchase through an official BKK channel.
